title: LoopTitan: What Does Parameter Revisit Buy a Mixture-of-Experts?
abstract: arXiv:2611.34821v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures revisit layer parameters across depths. This design increases effective depth without adding parameters. Recent looped MoE studies report substantial gains over the standard MoE at matched budgets (parameters, FLOPs and KV cache). However, the reported gains still confound parameter revisit with other design choices, e.g., network shape and residual scale. We ask, what does parameter revisit itself buy? Using matched non-revisit controls, we find that parameter revisit itself buys almost nothing. We argue that revisit only offers a freedom an MoE already has, i.e., trading experts for depth (more layers, fewer experts each) at fixed parameters. First, at matched budgets, we decompose the state-of-the-art looped recipe, with revisit last. A non-revisit control retains all the gain. Most comes from network shape, and the rest from residual scale. We prove this scale acts as a lower learning rat

translated_title: LoopTitan：参数重访能为混合专家模型带来什么？
translated_abstract: 循环混合专家架构在不同深度上重复使用层参数，这种设计在不增加参数的情况下增加了有效深度。近期的循环MoE研究报告称，在匹配的预算（参数量、FLOPs和KV缓存）下，其性能显著优于标准MoE。然而，所报告的性能提升仍然将参数重访与其他设计选择（如网络形状和残差缩放）混淆在一起。我们追问：参数重访本身能带来什么？通过使用匹配的非重访对照组，我们发现参数重访本身几乎没有带来任何收益。我们认为，重访只是提供了一种MoE本已拥有的自由，即在固定参数量的条件下用专家换深度（更多层，每层更少专家）。首先，在匹配预算下，我们分解了最先进的循环方案，并将重访放在最后应用，结果发现一个非重访对照组保留了全部收益，其中大部分来自网络形状，其余来自残差缩放。我们证明这种缩放起到了类似降低学习率的作用。
tldr: 研究发现循环MoE架构中参数重访本身几乎没有带来任何收益，其报告的性能提升实际来自网络形状和残差缩放等设计选择，而MoE本身已具备在固定参数量下用专家换深度的自由。
en_tdlr: Parameter revisit in looped MoE architectures buys almost nothing; the reported gains actually come from network shape and residual scale, as revisit merely offers a freedom MoE already has—trading experts for depth at fixed parameters.
